name: 우습네. 정말.
desc: Violet-black shadow pools bloom across the floor and dozens of thin black thorns stab upward from each one in a rapid chain. They sink back, then two huge black slashes cross into a screen-wide X that flares violet and shatters into thorn shards. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 모두의 언니
desc: A whirlwind of olive green paper sheets erupts upward from the center and rains down across the whole frame, mixed with tumbling coffee cups and soft green sparkles. The paper storm settles into a wide glowing circle that pulses once and fades. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 오오, 그 녀석은 성질이 좀 있지!
desc: A huge shadow beast surges up from a floor crack: writhing black tentacles and rows of bright yellow fangs sweep across the full width, biting. Then yellow iron cage bars slam down from above, trapping and crushing it into smoke that fades. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 지휘
desc: Four rhythmic lime green fire explosions burst at the four corners of the frame, one per beat, each larger than the last. On the final beat a towering wall of lime green flame with orange cores sweeps across the entire bottom and burns out in embers. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 붕괴 돌파
desc: An electric blue booster flare ignites at one edge and blasts straight across the whole frame as a thick comet trail with afterimages. It smashes into a white-hot impact burst at the far edge, scattering blue sparks and wall debris chunks that fall away. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 이건 꽝이에요
desc: A tall vertical hot pink laser curtain sweeps across the entire frame from left to right, leaving a grid of scan lines. Small target squares flash pink everywhere, then a big round pink stamp mark slams down in the center with a shockwave ring and fades. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 한 번 죽으면
desc: A frame-sized indigo clock ring with tick marks forms and spins backward, faster and faster, dragging streams of indigo light inward. It snaps tight, then explodes outward as a giant reversed shockwave with white shards before dissolving. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 가리키고, 보고, 쥐고
desc: Sky blue crosshair reticles lock on all over the frame, then wide translucent sky blue pressure fields lift upward. A colossal invisible hand-shaped wave of force slams down, flattening into a screen-wide ground shockwave with cracked rubble and dust. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 앙상블
desc: Dozens of glowing orchid purple puppet strings drop from the top edge and pull taut in a web over the frame, jerking left and right. All strings yank to one center point where a big starburst collision flashes white and purple, then strings snap and fall. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 제가 다 치울게요!
desc: A massive wave of bright pink-tinted junk, broken desks, crates and debris, rises at one edge and rolls across the whole frame like a bulldozer wall. A thick brown dust cloud trails behind, then everything rolls off the far edge and clears. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 정지
desc: Gray cracks spread across the whole frame like shattered glass as time freezes, everything desaturating. A huge translucent gray clock face stops mid-tick, then one razor-thin black line slices straight across and the frozen cracks burst apart. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 거짓말이 빠진 방
desc: The frame darkens at the edges as a single narrow bronze spotlight cone drops from the top, like an interrogation lamp. Fake mirror shards and false ghost outlines peel away and fall as gray pixel flakes, then the cone dims to black and fades. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 튜토리얼
desc: A giant blank peach orange banner frame unrolls and drops from the top, swinging. Below it, glowing peach warning arrows and dotted guide lines draw themselves over the whole frame, plus a protective dome outline, then all icons blink twice and vanish. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 팀 발표
desc: Five tall gold stage spotlight cones swing across the frame from above, searching, then lock in place one by one with sparkling rims. All five explode at once into golden starbursts and confetti that shower down and fade. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 영상 올리기 전에
desc: Dozens of slate blue-gray rectangular file windows with striped rows pop open in a grid across the whole frame, flickering like a laptop screen. Red seal bars lock across each window, then they all slam shut and collapse into a single dot. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 건물 가르기
desc: A single pure white 1px line appears across the full width at eye level, then flares into a blinding horizontal sword flash band, brightest at center. The frame splits into upper and lower halves that slide apart, then snap back with white sparks. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 킹
desc: A steel gray-blue chessboard grid draws itself across the floor with five glowing dotted pentagon points. Five steel slashes flash simultaneously at the points, then three precise heavy cuts strike the center, and the board shatters into square tiles. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 수고하십시오!
desc: Five red diagonal slash trails charge across the frame in a single file line, each leaving a crescent cut. They overlap into a fierce red streak of five-hit afterimages, then a burst of red sparks and small lime green ice bar sparkles rain down. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 예카테리나
desc: Teal wind spirals coil tighter and tighter at one side, sharpening into blades. A gigantic teal crescent sword gale fires straight across the full width, with smaller crescent echoes trailing behind, then frays into teal wind ribbons. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 후퇴는 없다
desc: Twin streams of gunmetal tracer fire with orange muzzle flashes sweep the entire forward frame for a sustained barrage. Spent shell casings cascade down. It ends with three rocket trails that erupt into three huge fireball explosions with smoke. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 진공작전
desc: All sound visually drains: amber ripples collapse inward into total stillness and a thin amber border frames the screen. Then a rapid storm of amber fist impact bursts pops all over the center, a dozen quick hits, and the border fades. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 채점 중
desc: A thick orange-gray smoke bomb puffs out to fill the frame. Inside, two blazing orange flamethrower cones and lobbed grenade arcs criss-cross, then both burst into big orange explosions with stitched seam lines tearing apart, smoke clearing. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 생환 기록
desc: A pulsing green survival aura ring flashes around the center and shoots up a column of green light. Endless green muzzle-flash pops and bullet streaks spray outward in all directions, and the ring flickers rapidly before a green heal burst fades. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 우리 팀 눈
desc: A sky blue radar sweep pulse expands from the floor center as wide perspective ellipses, rotating a bright beam across the whole frame. Blue target diamonds and weak-point markers light up everywhere, then the rings fade outward. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 무슨 소란인가
desc: A colossal eye opens across the whole top of the frame, dark teal iris with a fiery black slit pupil and dozens of tiny rolling pupils. Its glare ignites the ground into orange drought flames and dry cracks across the full width, then the eye closes. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 가장 소중한 것이 만나러 와요
desc: Golden amber fox fire wisps spiral in from all sides, multiplying into a ring of nine flames. They merge into one huge golden fox-flame shaped like a grinning mouth, which flares bright, then splits back into wisps that fly away and fade. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: A조에 온 걸 환영해
desc: Sea green light ribbons coil upward counterclockwise like a clock rewinding, rising from the floor in a broad spiral column. Healing sparkles stream backwards along the coils, then the column bursts into a soft sea green flower of light and fades. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 퇴근
desc: Ten lavender purple threads shoot out and swing across the frame, weaving a dense glowing web of twenty-plus straight lines. With one tug every line tightens at once and flashes white-hot, slicing, then the web snaps and drifts away like silk. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 다들 데리고 나왔어여
desc: A tall heavy cyan-gray steel door rises from the floor at center, swings open with blinding cyan light pouring from the gap, sucks inward like a vacuum, then slams shut with a huge shockwave and dust, sinking back down. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 물리 퇴마
desc: Bone white impact bursts hammer one spot in a rapid six-hit chain, each bigger, tearing white smoke wisps into shreds. The final blow erupts a massive white shockwave ring with ripped ghostly tatters scattering outward. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 통화 연결
desc: A royal blue phone signal pulse radiates in expanding arcs from the center, signal bars rising. The right side of the frame cracks open as a wall tears apart with a blue flash and rubble, then a big punch shockwave blasts through and settles. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 다시는 안 해
desc: A long earthy brown dust trail charges across the full width at ground level, stacked with speed lines and flying debris. It ends in a huge brown ground slam cloud that puffs up and slowly sinks down. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 추가 지급
desc: Venom purple vapor seeps from cracks and duct grates across the frame, forming twisting serpent-shaped smoke trails. They converge into one striking viper-head silhouette of purple smoke that lunges and bursts into poison sparks. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: R조의 양심
desc: A pale cream headlamp beam fans upward from the bottom, widening into a blinding full-frame white-cream flash. Bright cream marker rings pop up across the scene as weak points, then the glare contracts back into a single lamp dot. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 매뉴얼만 지키면요
desc: A shower of gold yellow coins rains down across the whole frame, bouncing and spinning. Glowing gold price tag shapes flip up everywhere, then a big golden auction hammer shockwave strikes the center and coins scatter outward. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 사람으로 대할 것
desc: Brown glowing links of light stretch from the center to many points like a protective net, forming a broad brown shield dome. The dome hardens with cracks, then pushes forward as a huge rolling brown wall shockwave that sweeps off the edge. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 분기별 기상 특보
desc: Lilac dream mist swirls into a huge vortex that fills the frame, with floating bubbles and starry specks. The vortex spirals inward and is sucked into a tiny glowing test tube shape, which sparkles lilac and fades. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 과장님!
desc: Dusky indigo schematic lines and gears unfold across the frame like a blueprint of the room's mechanisms. Each part disassembles, rotates and reassembles, then glowing indigo X marks stamp out every node and the diagram folds away. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 처음으로 쓸모 있어진 순간
desc: Red ink brush strokes of meaningless glyph fragments rise and swirl through the air around the center, glowing brighter. They burst outward in a ring of red calligraphy light, breaking chain-like seal patterns, then drift down as fading ash. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 완전 발현
desc: A gigantic black wolf-shaped shadow silhouette with scattered yellow eyes and white fangs charges across the full width, jaws gaping into a huge bite at center. Then the dark mass folds inward like paper and crumples into a dot, black fur specks drifting. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 두 번째 휴대전화
desc: A burgundy phone screen glow flashes, then two tall burgundy light pillars drop down at opposite edges like arrival beacons with ringing signal arcs. Burgundy sparks surge inward from both sides and collide in a central burst before fading. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 수정 요청 없음
desc: Sage green ruled document sheets unfold across the whole frame in rows of lined boxes, stacking like a contract. A giant round sage green blank stamp slams down in the center with a shockwave, the sheets flare and dissolve into paper dust. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 수술 여섯 시간째
desc: A huge round navy-rimmed surgical lamp descends from the top, then blasts a blinding white cone of light filling the frame. Navy suture lines stitch across the light in neat zigzags, tighten, and the glare fades to a soft glow. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 시술 준비 끝
desc: Soft peach bandage ribbons unroll and wrap in sweeping loops across the frame, interlaced with medical cross sparkles. The ribbons tighten into a broad peach healing ring that pulses three times, then unwinds and fades. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 헐값매입
desc: Dozens of maroon price tags flutter down across the whole frame. A huge maroon slashing strike cuts every tag in half, red sale marks flash, and the halves fall while golden loot sparkles are sucked toward one side. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 대박알선 뒷방
desc: Wine-red neon tubes flicker on around the frame edges like a seedy back room sign. A fan of spinning cards flies out in three directions, glowing wine red, then a heavy baseball bat swing arc smashes through the center in a burst of neon sparks. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 추심 시 사전 통보 없음
desc: A silver contract sheet slides into the center and emits silver hooked chains that lash out to many points, ripping glowing icons back inward. Then rapid silver dagger stab streaks zigzag across the frame in a flurry and vanish. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 영원한 십자군
desc: A massive translucent ivory white Gothic cathedral silhouette rises from below to fill the frame, golden stained-glass light beams streaming through its windows. Faceless armored knight silhouettes raise swords, then a blinding holy flash bursts. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 메카의 군세
desc: A charge of translucent blue spectral horse cavalry silhouettes with faceless helmets thunders across the full width, shaking the ground. Behind them blue phantom infantry rise from the earth with spears, then the whole host fades into blue light. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 모래 해일
desc: A towering wall of emerald-tinged sand rises from the back of the frame, curling into a giant tsunami with golden spray at the crest. It crashes forward across the whole width, then collapses into flowing dunes and sand dust. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 붉은 눈
desc: Two glowing crimson eye pupils flare at center, then concentric crimson shockwave rings ripple outward across the entire frame in waves. Hypnotic spiral patterns pulse within the rings, and the frame edges glow red before the waves fade. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 화요퀴즈쇼
desc: A row of mint green stage light pillars descends from the top with sparkling bulb borders, sweeping like a TV studio. Big circle and X shaped panels flash alternately, then all lights converge into one blinding spotlight beam at center. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.

name: 예술은 조각이다
desc: A flowing vermilion ribbon of looping calligraphic strokes streams endlessly across the frame. Wherever it passes, gray marble veins spread and freeze into chiseled stone shards, then everything cracks and crumbles into sculpture fragments. Crisp pixel art, transparent background, no characters, no people, no text. 12-16 frames.
